newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Thierry Daman said the Commission was discussing the EU/U.S. dispute on meat hygiene inspection methods. He said spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas would brief reporters after Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard's news conference, in the afternoon.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/259: The European Commission has decided to propose further labelling of genetically modified organisms.
- IP/97/261: State aid: France - The Commission extends the examination of support measures in favour of the Societe de Banque Ociidentale (SDBO) opened on September 18, 1996.
- IP/97/263: State aid: Spain - The Commission decides to close the procedure relating to the national programme for the development of renewable energies.
- IP/97/264: State aid: United Kingdom - Commission approves an investment aid package to LG Electronics Wales Ltd, South Wales.
- Speech/97/75: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on the European Union and Lithuania.
- European Economy - Supplement C - No 1 - February 1997: Bank restructuring in Europe.
- Eurostat news release No 25/97: Growth in EU GDP: 1.59% in 1996.
